direction:
## Cover direction

- **Game interface designer.** Use the two-layer mark as the cover's single image. The ring shows what was sent and the fill shows what is wanted now. Make it large enough that a red ring around an ink fill reads as "not done yet" at thumbnail size.
- **Watch restorer.** Set five marks in one fixed vertical column. Only row 3 grows to carry the idea. The other four stay small and agree with themselves, so the column holds steady around the one moving part.
- **Control room operator.** Keep the paper quiet: one surface, hairline rules, no texture. The edge between sent and wanted is the only loud contrast on the page. Send appears once as a count, "Send 1".
- **Lunar archivist.** Show the reversal as a findable record. The ledger keeps "#1 Cut 3" visible and adds "Restore 3 · reverses #1" below it. The cover writes a new line and erases nothing.

**Composition.** The left column holds the title at 100px, a one-line task descriptor, the date, and a two-line ledger near the bottom margin. The right column at x 1040 holds five marks on hairline row rules. Marks 1, 2, 4 and 5 are small ink rings with ink fills. Mark 3 is 190px across, with a red ring around an ink fill. A small red dot follows the title, taken from the unsent-title-dot rule. The margins are 72px.

**Palette.** Paper #F2EEE6. Ink #14181F. Cut red #BE4D4D. Restore blue #2F5E9E. Sam Creates navy #0E2A47 is used only for the top rule, row rules and row numbers.

**Type treatment.** `Cover Headline` sets the title at 100px with −0.02em tracking in ink. `Cover Text` sets the descriptor at 27px, the date at 20px with wide tracking, and the ledger at 19px with tabular numerals.
